## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Change category

- [ ] Documentation or repository metadata only
- [ ] Interactive application; publication benchmark unaffected
- [ ] Simulation/statistical semantics; fresh affected simulation required
- [ ] Deterministic publication/validation/packaging; simulation and raw outputs unchanged
- [ ] Validated publication evidence from the canonical HPC publisher

## Scientific and evidence impact

State whether this changes policy behavior, peer communication, context
channels, PINN behavior, outcomes, stochastic streams, scenarios, learning,
hypotheses, estimands, inferential rules, figures, validation, or evidence
packaging. Simulation/statistical-semantic changes require a fresh affected
treatment. A deterministic publication change may use preserved outputs only
through the authorized dual-provenance procedure in
`docs/PUBLICATION_RECOVERY.md`. If neither applies, explain why.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.
